authorityPrecedence: Newest explicit owner feedback and direct live-Figma comparison against locked P01/P02 CURRENT pages override earlier grouped-regeneration PASS declarations and older P03 main-manifest execution details.

visualMaster.rule: Use P03 Visual Master for local composition, hierarchy, photo count and information relationships. It does not license a different dominant illustration genre from the active V30 publication family.

liveFigma.rule: Update CURRENT 3535:11 only. Do not create a duplicate P03 and do not modify P01/P02/P04-P08.

crossPageStyleAnchors.principle: P03 keeps its own story-page composition, but major display art, editorial papers, travel/tropical ornament treatment and story navigation must look art-directed by the same V30 publication team as P01/P02.
v30StyleDNA: crisp printed/sticker-like silhouettes rather than painterly illustration plates
strong dark outlines or equivalent high-contrast edge definition on high-saliency display art
white/yellow/bright keylines and controlled dimensional shadows where useful
clean cream/white paper surfaces with clear colored framing rather than aged parchment
tropical/travel motifs rendered as lively editorial cutouts/stickers, not watercolor botanical studies
tactile print character is restrained and graphic, not sepia/vintage
mixed media stays inside one bounded realism/texture range
hardRejects: watercolor or painterly botanical illustration as a dominant high-saliency P03 language
fine-art church/tropical rendering that reads like an illustration plate
one page mixing painterly vintage blocks with flat SVG flowchart elements
passing attractive individual objects when the overall publication family is inconsistent

ownerRejectedCurrentTargets.reason: These implementations either drift from the active P01/P02 V30 family or preserve the flowchart/isolated-icon assembly problem. Previous PASS labels are superseded.

newGroupedProductionModel.principle: Use fewer, larger editorial ecologies. Do not solve P03 with isolated clipart/SVG parts and do not flatten the whole page.

blocks.styleRule: Match P01/P02 V30 graphic/sticker/print energy. No watercolor, vintage parchment, painterly botanical or retro-poster treatment.
Use clean bright V30 editorial paper comparable to P02, not aged parchment/scrapbook paper. Q3/Q4 stay non-identical but one family.

include: camera/palm and only necessary fixed local accents
blocks.photoRule: Step1-4 support photos remain independently replaceable; Step5 remains no-photo.
blocks.styleRule: Read as one irregular magazine story composition. Route is editorial movement, not connector-diagram grammar.
hardRejects: five separate heart badges next to an independent dotted connector

blocks.styleRule: Same bold editorial cutout/sticker family as P01/P02. No watercolor church, realistic botanical plate, painterly tide or vintage travel-poster treatment.

microOrnamentRule.principle: P03_STEP3_CAMERA, P03_STEP2_PALM, P03_HERO_LOWER_PLUMERIA and similar accents do not survive as isolated assets by default. Integrate into the nearest grouped ecology when genuinely needed, otherwise remove them.
microOrnamentRule.hardReject: Do not regenerate a new isolated icon simply because the old isolated icon was rejected.

executionOrder: compare P01 3535:7, P02 3535:9 and P03 3535:11 side-by-side before generating
generate one representative P03 V30-aligned calibration ecology/sample first; do not generate the entire replacement batch until that sample passes cross-page style review
rebuild Header ecology in V30-aligned graphic language
rebuild Q3/Q4 as one calibrated bright editorial-paper family
rebuild Timeline + fixed local accents + Wedding Day/date as one grouped Story ecology
rebuild Bottom closure in V30-aligned graphic language
remove superseded isolated camera/palm/plumeria/route/label/Wedding-Day nodes after replacements win visually
run one full-page P01/P02/P03 cross-page comparison plus P03 Visual Master/A5 review
run alpha/material and fingerprint checks only on new grouped blocks
completionCondition: P03 may return to FIGMA_DESIGN_COMPLETE=YES only when direct P01/P02/P03 side-by-side review passes CROSS_PAGE_STYLE_FAMILY_PASS, the story/timeline reads as one authored magazine-story ecology rather than a diagram, P03 local composition remains intact, and photos/pending body copy remain separately editable/replaceable.
